property_summary: For any recipient, getFirstWithdrawalBonus should never revert due to an external call failure when the contract has sufficient balance; the buggy version can revert when called by an already-claimed recipient because rewardsForA is not incremented and the external call sends 0 to a recipient that reverts on 0-value calls.
change_summary: Replace require(!claimedBonus[recipient]) with require(claimedBonus[recipient]), inverting the restriction so only already-claimed recipients get an additional bonus.
